name: inkscape-flowed-text-card
story: A community-broadcaster volunteer reopened last year's Inkscape file and drew a full-frame announcement card whose two-sentence body paragraph is a dragged text box, so it exports as SVG 1.2 <flowRoot> that no browser paints.
idioms: the flowRegion rect keeps a real fill (style="fill:#000000") even though it only defines the box
transform="translate(0,0)" left on the flowRoot by an edit that was undone
id="base" on <sodipodi:namedview> - the 0.92-era name, not namedview1
svg id="svg2" / defs id="defs2" numbering from the older document
inkscape:label on the flowRoot itself ("Body copy") as well as on the live text objects
high serial ids (text3090, tspan3089, rect3104) from a long-edited file
line-height and letter-spacing in the style attribute, no presentation attributes
whyThisMatters: The paragraph is visible in Inkscape and invisible everywhere NoaCG renders, so an import that stays silent hands the volunteer a card that looks finished in the wizard and goes to air with its whole body copy missing - and an import that offers the flowPara as an operator field is worse, because the operator then types into text nobody will ever see.
